title: Report a lost or found item
content: Residents can create a lost or found report in the Emerald Housing portal. The lost and found board displays reports available to the signed-in resident. Use the report form to describe the item and submit it for the society's lost and found workflow.

title: Respond to a lost and found report
content: A resident can submit a claim against a published lost and found report through the portal. Authorised society staff review submitted claims through the society's workflow.

title: View community notices
content: Residents can view the community notice board in the Emerald Housing portal. Notices are shown according to their audience and publication status.

title: Maintenance request tracking
content: Residents can create maintenance requests for their own flats and check the current status and progress of a request in the Emerald Housing portal. Request information is available only to accounts with permission for the request's flat.

title: Rental workflow features
content: The Emerald Housing portal provides rental workflow features, including viewing bookings, rental payment schedules, and receipts. Availability depends on the resident's access and the relevant rental record.
